name: 检查线申请→执行→报告回写率

sides.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS APPLIED, SUM(CASE WHEN EXAM_DATE_TIME IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS EXECUTED, SUM(CASE WHEN REPORT_DATE_TIME IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REPORTED FROM EXAM.EXAM_MASTER WHERE REQ_DATE_TIME >= TO_DATE(:START_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AND REQ_DATE_TIME < TO_DATE(:END_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD')
